materials.name: gear

materials.wears: the soft fabric plate carrier vest, the row of pouches across the stomach, the short tactical gloves, and the lace-up combat boots, which are tan suede with tan soles and tan laces and end a hand above the ankle. The gloves are plain tan fabric all over, close-fitting, ending at the wrist in a plain narrow hem. Also tan: the two straps that hold each shin guard on, each a broad flat band of tan webbing round the shin with a plain tan buckle. Every strap and buckle in the outfit is this same tan.

materials.name: plates
materials.look: BRIGHT LIGHT SKY BLUE hard plastic, a saturated baby blue (hex #78AAE6), clearly coloured and as light as the tan

Each knee pad is one rounded shell centred on the knee, sewn flat onto the trouser leg. Each shin guard is one long shell on the front of the shin, starting a hand below its knee pad, with a band of grey trouser showing between the two, and ending at the top of the boot. Every shell is plainly bright sky blue all over.

prompt:
Product image of one women's security uniform for a near-future corporate facility guard, standing in an A-pose. It is made for a woman with a full figure, and its shape shows it: the shirt and the vest are moulded over a full bust, so that the chest stands out in two clearly rounded forms seen from the front, with a narrow waist below them, rounder hips and narrower shoulders. Show the clothing and gear only, as a hollow outfit floating in the air with nobody inside it: the collar and the hems of the two short sleeves are empty openings, and the two gloves float on their own, apart from the sleeves.

Pose, the most important thing in this image: a strict A-pose, like a 3D character model sheet. The two short sleeves are straight tubes that point sideways and downward, each one 45 degrees away from the body, each ending in a straight clean hem. Each glove floats far out to the side at hip height, on the same straight line as its sleeve, open and flat with the fingers together, pointing along that line. Between the hem of each sleeve and its glove is a long stretch of plain white background, as long as the sleeve and the glove together. Between each sleeve and the torso there is an empty wedge of white background that starts right at the armpit; the whole underside of each sleeve from armpit to hem shows against white. Legs straight, feet shoulder width apart, a clear gap between the legs all the way up.

{materials}
The grey cloth is clearly greyer and darker than the tan gear, and the tan gear is clearly browner than the cloth. The blue shells are clearly bluer and lighter than the grey cloth. Every part of the outfit is one of these three colours, and every strap is tan.

{construction}

Smooth clean surfaces like a painted sculpt: plain colour on every part, clean and new, matte plastic, smooth cloth with only large soft folds, simple chunky shapes, clean edges between parts.

Camera: straight front view, camera level with the chest, long lens with almost no perspective. The outfit stands upright and symmetrical.

Soft even studio lighting with gentle shading that shows the forms, the whole outfit in frame from collar to boot soles and from glove to glove with margin on all sides, plain white background.
